[[Category:Scripting Commands by Functionality]]

The "Weapon pool" is a feature first introduced in [[{{ofpr}}]] and made fully MP compatible in [[Arma 2: Private Military Company|Arma 2: PMC]].
Over the course of a campaign, it enables the player to store weapons and magazines from one mission and makes them available in the following scenarios.
The stored items are available through the briefing gear selection and can be stored to specific object in order to make them available even during a mission.

A campaign allows weapons to be stored by default but will not show them in briefing selection. To enable this feature, put the following line in the {{Link|Campaign Description.ext#weaponPool|Campaign's Description.ext}}:
<syntaxhighlight lang="cpp">weaponPool = true;</syntaxhighlight>
